description: Full-text search with filters, sorting, facets, pagination and highlights. Use when the user looks something up in the app's own data. Before: search_get_index for the fields. Returns hits (id, score, document, highlights), total, facets, took_ms and the receipt. Scope: search:query. Cost: paid, reserved on the prepaid balance before the call (released if it fails); prices: get_pricing. Short balance or limit: next_action top_up_balance or raise_app_spend_limit.

facets.description: Fields to count values of (up to 100 values each).

filter.description: Closed filter tree: {"field": f, "eq"|"ne"|"in"|"gt"|"gte"|"lt"|"lte"|"exists": v}, or {"and": [...]}, {"or": [...]}, {"not": {...}}.

highlight.description: Return escaped excerpts with <mark> tags. Default true.

q.description: Text to find. Quotes make a phrase, a leading - excludes a word. Empty: all documents.

sort.description: Up to 3 sort keys; ties break by relevance then id.

typo_tolerance.description: Match small typos. Default: the index setting.

name: query_search_index
title: Search an index
